lines: Hello. I was keeping this corner company.
Give the sunny corner room. Odd jobs works better without elbows in it.
Step carefully near the sunny corner. I would rather greet you than patch you up.
There you are. I was watching everyone work and trying to look busy.
Hello. I was thinking about corners.
You arrived at a good time, unless you meant to arrive earlier.
Hi. I am busy in a way that is hard to document.
Careful where you stand. That shadow was using the spot.
Hello there. I was just supervising the air.
I have a moment. I had several, actually.
Good to see you. I think I saw you first, unless you did.
Come closer if you are not carrying a serious face.
I was watching a barrel. It blinked first in spirit.
Hello. The day seems mostly assembled.
If you need help, I can point with confidence.
You caught me between thoughts. Wide space, that.
Stand anywhere. I have not assigned the ground today.
Hi. Did you bring news or just footsteps?
I am listening with both ears and a spare guess.
